fixed_packet_allocation: Each original tensor component grid point is one fixed fractional packet, Mi=w_k/q_k^n. Coincident points retain original component contributions and sum to full mu. No new physical source or normalization.
band_rule: j>=0, theta_j=2^(-j-1), theta_j<p<=2theta_j. Exact p=2^(-k) belongs to j=k.
frozen: Full mu, receiver x, continuous [1,2] full-source winner R, full m, M, tau and E unchanged. Use existing saved integer per-axis capture counts; no oracle execution.
checks: Each component q_k^n Mi equals w_k; total fixed packet mass W=1.
Captured multiplicity Nk=product existing counts; sum Nk Mi=m.
Captured packet fullness=1; uncaptured fullness=0. Only positive captured multiplicities enter bands.
sum Nk p=1; grouped theta counts lie in [1/2,1), with exact endpoint convention.
Each original packet counted once per receiver; merge counts only within same band.
Saved M=m/R^n and E=(M>tau) checked exactly; E-gated row keeps zero outside E.
claims_excluded: No Lebesgue coverage probability from these 24 deterministic probes.
No source integration, source profile square, cross-band square budget, dimension order or actual geom endpoint proof.
Changing from global layer packets to fixed single-gridpoint packets fixes fullness but does not itself pay cross-band interaction.
complexity: 24*4 products of <=64 saved integer counts and rational band comparisons. No q^n enumeration, no MC and no random seeds added.
